name: dcc-superpower-companions
description: Extends superpowers with 19 tiered subagents and an external executor lane. Scores every plan task on a four-axis rubric that sends over-scoring tasks back to be split, routes score-2..4 low-risk tasks to Codex for quota offload, dispatches with a defined escalation ladder, and scores task reviews against named criteria with a cross-family review seat.
